scientific_question: Does the already-fixed C074-D O/U2.5 open-to-close movement scalar add stable information for q(k|T>=7,X) after a match has already entered the 7+ public bucket?
claim_boundary: development-only on previously opened C074-E market domain; not independent confirmation; formal_weight=0; unified score matrix remains closed

source.market_semantics: average O/U2.5 opening and closing prices only; no immutable per-row quote timestamp; single line; research-level coarse-PIT evidence

population.reuse: exact C074-E valid-row parsing, league/team identity, same-date predict-before-update history and both-team >=8 prior result gate
population.target_subset: eligible rows with realized exact total T>=7

estimand.target: q(E=e | T>=7, X) on infinite nonnegative support

baseline.fit: r = total continuation events / total survival exposures among training-fold T>=7 rows

candidate.expanded_survival_rows: for each tail match E, create j=0..E with continue=1 if j<E else 0; same movement scalar repeated; no step index

all_required: coverage gate passes before effect interpretation
paired bootstrap 90% upper bound for LogLoss delta < 0
at least 4 of 5 chronological folds have LogLoss delta < 0
at least half of league clusters with >=15 pooled tail test rows have LogLoss delta < 0
frozen_gate.decision: STOP_COVERAGE if coverage fails; SCIENTIFIC_COMPONENT_PASS_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY only if every gate passes; otherwise FAIL_PARK

stopping_rule: After this result, do not tune C, movement transform, opening-price level, feature subset, fold definitions, league subset or survival/distribution family on the scored C075-B tail labels. A failure parks this representation.
